group_home_text: 👋 Hello! Press 🎲 New game. Then players press ✅ Join. Host presses ▶️ Start when 3–6 players. I don’t spam — I edit one message.
private_start_text: 👋 Hi! How to play (kid-easy): 1) Add me to a group 2) In the group press 🎲 New game 3) Players press ✅ Join 4) Host presses ▶️ Start when 3–6 players You can change 🌐 Language anytime.
lobby_hint: Tap ✅ Join. Host taps ▶️ Start when 3–6 players. 🔄 Refresh only updates this screen. You don’t need it if everything looks correct.
help_text: Help 1) 🎲 New game 2) ✅ Join 3) ▶️ Start (host) 🔄 Refresh only updates the screen if Telegram didn’t refresh. One screen — no spam.
rules_text: Rules M1: Lobby only. Create game → Join → Start. Full game later.
